skipatstart + big32count;","note":"The parsed-pattern buffer size is derived from the attacker-controlled pattern length, so an oversized or specially shaped input can drive the lexer into a heap allocation and subsequent out-of-bounds access in the parsing path."},{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/pcre/src/pcre2_compile.c","function":"compile_branch","line":10032,"var":"cb.parsed_pattern","code":"errorcode = parse_regex(ptr, cb.external_options, &has_lookbehind, &cb);","note":"The vulnerable sink is the lexer writing parsed tokens into the heap-backed parsed_pattern buffer while walking the attacker input; the reported issue is a heap-buffer-overflow in this lexer path."}]
